measured.scope: Historical measurements on 2026-10-20, from the immutable audit and lazy-screening run/job URLs above; not current runtime claims.

limitations: These are admission-planning allowances, not measured full-candidate audit durations or guaranteed upper bounds.
The host scaling uses one module and may not predict other tests; runtime reserve checks and deadlines must fail closed if the comparison no longer fits.
All four complete populations are required; a partial population permits no comparative speed claim.
Two independent clones per pass are retained; the disk allowance is a conservative planning reservation, not a proved bound on all test output.
No parallel performance gain is assumed for admission. A slower parallel side may make the complete comparison infeasible.
Two samples per side remain preliminary screening, not the five-sample minimum or end-to-end production qualification.
All raw reports, temporary files and clones remain until disposable-runner teardown; no artifact upload or private clinical corpus.
